constant_columns_disclosed.kept_anyway_because: the contract is then mechanically derivable from NODE_FEATURE_DEFINITIONS with no human selection step; removing them would be a judgment call and cherry-picking inputs is exactly what a preregistration should prevent
constant_columns_disclosed.why: node_kind_onehot is (1,0,0) on every root because FD24LocalModelBatch requires every root to be NODE_SELF, and relative_position_spacing and distance_range are 'self is exact zero' by the frozen feature schema

layout.content: masked SELF-applicable node_x values, value * mask
the corresponding validity masks as float32 0.0/1.0
the six frozen local aggregate statistics

missing_value_handling.rule: the sentinel values declared per aggregate above
missing_value_handling.why_no_extra_mask_bit_is_needed: aggregates 50 and 51 encode P and O exactly and invertibly, so the reader can always tell 'no peer observed' from 'a peer at the range boundary'. The sentinels are therefore never ambiguous.

model: one hidden layer, width 32, ReLU, single logit output, no message passing
name: M1_LOCAL_NON_GRAPH_INPUT_CONTRACT_V1
normalization: no new normalization is introduced. Columns 0..49 are already dimensionless under EGO_GRAPH_NORMALIZATION_VERSION. Counts use the parameter-free saturating map c/(1+c), which needs no reference constant and is invertible on the integers.
